freshness_window.rationale: Canonical window = today (2026-05-26) minus freshness_days=14. Most-recent persisted entities (cloudflare/upwork-2026-05-07) sit just outside this window, so the plan targets net-new announcements after 2026-05-12.

params.query: company announces layoffs workforce reduction May 2026

queries.rationale: Broad news-category sweep for any layoff announcement in the window. Anchors the discover funnel; high recall, low precision — downstream dedup/extractor filters.

params.query: AI restructuring layoffs automation displacing workers 2026

queries.rationale: Targets sector=ai + reason_stated=ai-restructuring / automation — the dominant 2026 narrative (Cloudflare-style 'AI now core to our workforce' framings).

params.query: WARN notice filing 8-K SEC workforce reduction restructuring plan

queries.rationale: Authoritative-source path per README rule: WARN filings + 8-K exhibits give exact layoff_count / layoff_percentage / sec_filing_url with high confidence.

params.query: bank fintech finance company layoffs job cuts cost cutting 2026

queries.rationale: Sector-balancing query so the plan isn't tech-monoculture. Schema enum 'finance' is well-represented in 2026 cost-cutting cycles; complements q1's broad sweep with a deliberately narrowed sector variant.

params.query: (layoffs OR "job cuts" OR "workforce reduction") -filter:retweets lang:en since:2026-05-12 until:2026-05-26

queries.rationale: Catches CEO/company official posts on X — direct path to official_statement_url + reason_excerpt. Two-tool minimum satisfier.

params.query: ("difficult decision" OR "reducing our team" OR "saying goodbye" OR "restructuring") (layoffs OR "job cuts") -filter:retweets lang:en since:2026-05-12 until:2026-05-26

queries.rationale: CEO-statement phrasing pattern — the canonical 'memo-style' opener. Targets ceo_name + reason_excerpt fields and corroborates exa hits via social channel.

notes: 6 queries (1.5x min) at $0.06 leaves $0.14 headroom — enough for searcher to retry the prior base/USDC opaque-500s on solana/USDC fallback rails for every query. q4 deliberately repeats the news-broad slice as a sector-narrowed variant (per Strategies clause). All exa queries set startPublishedDate/endPublishedDate; both twitter queries embed since:/until: operators.
